description: This file provides extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure Azure Blob Storage as the grain storage provider in Orleans hosting. It includes methods to add Azure Blob Grain Storage as default or named storage with optional configuration actions.

classes.name: AzureBlobGrainStorageServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to facilitate configuration of Azure Blob Storage grain storage in Orleans.

methods.name: AddAzureBlobGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the service collection to use Azure Blob Storage as the default grain storage, accepting a configuration action for options.

methods.name: AddAzureBlobGrainStorage
methods.description: Adds Azure Blob Storage as a named grain storage provider, with an optional configuration action.
